title: Document shows Pandolfi supplying gravitational-wave briefers for the Jasons

tellings.quote: there, but there's a a document was found about uh gravitational waves where he was finding the speakers. There's it shows Ron Bendalf's providing this the the briefers.

plain: A document about gravitational waves turned up showing that a man named Ron Pandolfi was finding the speakers, the briefers, for the Jasons, an elite group of scientists who advise the US government. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels about it without saying where the document came from or when it is dated. Cameron raises it because it would show Pandolfi quietly arranging high-level scientific briefings on advanced physics.
